vulnerabilities.description: navigateToClaim deletes a dangling ref from the negative cache immediately after refresh, so repeated clicks can trigger repeated full snapshot and claims projection reads instead of honoring the configured TTL.

edgeCasesMissed: No test repeats a still-dangling reference click after its refresh completes to prove the negative-cache TTL prevents repeated snapshot-wide reads.
No server-side latency or payload-size assertion exercises graph://claims?scope=snapshot with a large tenant; current scale coverage measures only client reverse-index construction.
A rejected snapshot claims projection is not caught by ClaimsBrowser's effect, leaving reverse-index hydration without an explicit user-visible recovery state.

passed: packages/mcp-server resource, query, and history tests: 10/10
security: Claims reads remain tenant-scoped and use bound SQLite parameters.
Snapshot projection defensively isolates corrupt refs JSON and redacts repository paths.
Latest-request sequencing prevents stale query responses from replacing current results.
React-rendered claim and history content exposes no direct HTML injection sink.
